scope: test-only existing executor/lifecycle observation, KSP inventory unchanged
admission: branded Runtime plus static bootstrap main/owner-env/current-epoch gate before provider call; old epoch rejected before owner lookup
liveness: BusinessBodyActive spans actual run; BusinessExitHeld spans its real condition wait before body return. CleanupJoinCallInFlight brackets the actual pthread_join invocation/return on the existing libuv work job, not a kernel wait-state sample. OwnerEntryActive means the owner currently executes this snapshot callback.
comparisons: pthread_equal on actual owner, worker and join-caller pthread_t while all three live with exit held; otherwise fields7/8/9 are UINT64_MAX unknown. Never stringify/cast pthread_t or use pthread_kill.
tls: test-only pthread-key destructor marker proves its own destructor, not Kotlin private TLS counters; actual successful pthread_join is the physical thread/TLS exit witness
retirement: before actual executor destruction snapshot is copied into existing ExecutionProbe diagnostic storage; observed destroy success sets field19. No pointer is retained. New epoch invalidates the previous completed snapshot.
cleanup: only genuine platform env cleanup hook releases a test exit hold automatically. Public control does not simulate that hook. Normal close waits for explicit test release.
final_gate: same epoch: live business/hold/join flags0, native TLS marker and join counts paired, destroyed1, errors0; separate full110 physical ACK remains mandatory
failure: unknown snapshot/absent executor is Closed; duplicate/late arm ResourceExhausted; invalid action/unarmed release InvalidArgument; stale Runtime InvalidHandleRetired; native failure BridgeFailure
